Before calling submit_result, STOP and explicitly verify each item below. If ANY item fails, run a corrective query FIRST and only then submit.

args.sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
  SELECT
    c.cust_city,
    t.calendar_quarter_id,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM complex_oracle.main.sales AS s
  JOIN complex_oracle.main.customers AS c
    ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN complex_oracle.main.times AS t
    ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE
    c.country_id = 52790 AND s.promo_id = 999 AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
  GROUP BY
    c.cust_city,
    t.calendar_quarter_id
), qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT
    cust_city
  FROM city_sales
  WHERE
    calendar_quarter_id = 1772
  INTERSECT
  SELECT
    cust_city
  FROM city_sales
  WHERE
    calendar_quarter_id = 1776
), sales_by_quarter AS (
  SELECT
    cs.cust_city,
    cs.calendar_quarter_id,
    cs.total_sales
  FROM city_sales AS cs
  JOIN qualifying_cities AS qc
    ON cs.cust_city = qc.cust_city
), sales_growth AS (
  SELECT
    s1.cust_city
  FROM sales_by_quarter AS s1
  JOIN sales_by_quarter AS s2
    ON s1.cust_city = s2.cust_city
  WHERE
    s1.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 AND s2.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 AND s2.total_sales >= 1.2 * s1.total_sales
), product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    p.prod_name,
    t.calendar_quarter_id,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM complex_oracle.main.sales AS s
  JOIN complex_oracle.main.products AS p
    ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
  JOIN complex_oracle.main.customers AS c
    ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN complex_oracle.main.times AS t
    ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE
    c.country_id = 52790 AND s.promo_id = 999 AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776) AND c.cust_city IN (
      SELECT
        cust_city
      FROM sales_growth
    )
  GROUP BY
    p.prod_name,
    t.calendar_quarter_id
), ranked_products AS (
  SELECT
    prod_name,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS quintile
  FROM product_sales
  WHERE
    calendar_quarter_id = 1776
), top_products AS (
  SELECT
    prod_name
  FROM ranked_products
  WHERE
    quintile = 1
), sales_share AS (
  SELECT
    ps.prod_name,
    ps.calendar_quarter_id,
    ps.total_sales / SUM(ps.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ps.calendar_quarter_id) AS share
  FROM product_sales AS ps
  JOIN top_products AS tp
    ON ps.prod_name = tp.prod_name
), sales_share_change AS (
  SELECT
    s1.prod_name,
    s2.share - s1.share AS share_change
  FROM sales_share AS s1
  JOIN sales_share AS s2
    ON s1.prod_name = s2.prod_name
  WHERE
    s1.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 AND s2.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
)
SELECT
  prod_name
FROM sales_share_change
ORDER BY
  ABS(share_change)
LIMIT 1
